data.text: User explicitly requests hosted Claude to implement actual backend features/code changes and be able to merge them into this repository. Add opt-in checked automatic merge for scoped application changes after trusted isolated validation, with authorization captured on exact request dispatch. Model never gets merge/write credentials; trusted workflow handles publication/merge. Protected credentials/release controls/purchasing authority/dependencies/migrations/hardware remain manual; Mac installation remains exact-SHA owner approval. This replaces the prior assumption that every generated PR needs another owner merge confirmation; user authorizes merging setup PR16 after passing checks to activate and verify this capability.
data.rationale: User steering: 'code changes should work as well' followed by 'it should be able to merge it into the repo as well'. Preserve existing supplier, hardware and local-runtime boundaries.
